newsitem.title: MEXICO: Son of top Mexican politician kidnapped - radio.
newsitem.headline: Son of top Mexican politician kidnapped - radio.

text.p: Mexican radio on Thursday reported that the son of one of Mexico's best-known politicians was kidnapped in Mexico City, but family members sought to play down the report.
Privately run Radio Red said Ruben Figueroa Smutny was seized in the capital.

In the southern state of Guerrero, where the victim's father Ruben Figueroa Alcocer was governor until March 1996 when he stepped down in disgrace, local radio said the family's lawyer Sergio Sotomayor confirmed the abduction.
But Figueroa Alcocer was later quoted by the state news agency Notimex as denying his son was abducted.
"My son is not kidnapped, he is travelling," he told reporters. "I urge you with all my heart, please, to transmit that, as I just said it."

Figueroa Alcocer, head of a family that has long been one of the most politically influential in Mexico, stepped down as governor last year after he was widely accused of playing a role in the massacre of 17 peasants in Guerrero in June 1995.
Guerrero media reports said his kidnapped son is 30 and runs a passenger coach firm in Mexico City. He is believed to have been seized Wednesday.
